Heavy Duty Drying Towel – 1200gsm

  • 1200GSM dual-layer construction
  • Extreme absorbency
  • Safe on all paint

About this product

Double-sided plush microfibre construction designed to pull water off paint with almost no effort.

Fewer passes and faster drying with less contact to help prevent streaks, smears and unwanted marks.

Cars, SUVs, vans, paintwork, glass and exterior plastics.

How to use it

Use only on clean, shampooed paint.

Tech Specs

GSM: 1200GSM. Size: 90 × 60 cm. Material: microfibre.

FAQ’s

What’s the difference between this and the XL 800GSM towel?

The Heavy Duty towel is thicker at 1200GSM and double-sided, so it holds more water and feels more substantial in the hand. The XL 800GSM towel is larger in size but lighter in feel, so it glides a bit easier. It mainly comes down to whether you prefer a lighter, larger towel or a smaller, heavier one.

Will this towel scratch my paint?

No, not when used correctly. Only use it on clean, shampooed paint.
